## Summary

Describe the user-visible contract or internal change.

## Validation

- [ ] `scripts/validate.sh`
- [ ] Generated JupyterLab/VSIX assets were rebuilt when frontend sources changed.
- [ ] Tracked notebooks have no outputs, counts, local paths, credentials, or local state.
- [ ] Documentation, compatibility, security, and packaging implications were reviewed.

## Release note

- [ ] Added an entry under `CHANGELOG.md` → `Unreleased`.
- [ ] If no note is appropriate, requested the `release-note:exempt` label and
      recorded the rationale below.

## Sensitive-data check

- [ ] This change contains no credentials, private query data, internal identifiers, or machine paths.
